note: Full step-by-step bodies with complete code live in the plan .md. Phase 1 is gated on a BEHAVIOUR contract, not pixel identity: every list changes appearance by design, so an identity gate would fail on success. Each description carries Goal/Files/Acceptance Criteria/Verify plus its json:metadata fence, which is what TaskGet returns to an implementing subagent.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Behaviour harness for the one list
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Assert what must survive the re-skin — items, ordering, selection movement, scroll boundary, value text, edit mode — WITHOUT asserting pixels.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Why not pixels:** Phase 1 changes every list's chrome on purpose. A pixel-identity gate would fail on success and pass only if the work were skipped. Order still matters: write these against the list as it behaves TODAY. Commit before Task 2.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/host/test_list_behavior.sh`
- Create: `tools/param-pages/list_probe.mjs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- probe captures labels, values, selected index, edit brackets
- assertions cover 3-item, 12-item at 0/6/11, empty value, action item, editMode
- probe records TEXT, never x/y
- all pass against today's drawMenuList
- commit touches only test + probe

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_list_behavior.sh`

tasks.subject: Task 8: Accessor routing with persistence pinned
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reads and writes reach the right backend, and every write that must persist does.

`adjustMasterFxSetting` (`shadow_ui.js:13912`) is delta-based and side-effectful: most branches also call `saveMasterFxChainConfig()` and set a cached var. A writeParam that skips either sets the param and loses it on reboot — silently.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui_global_grid.mjs` (PERSISTING_KEYS, writeGlobalParam)
- Modify: `src/shadow/shadow_ui.js` (globalGridIoFor near slotGridIoFor ~9640)
- Modify: `tests/host/test_global_settings_contract.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- each key routes to its correct backend
- all six MUST_PERSIST keys call persist() on write
- cache vars still written
- test fails when a persisting key skips its persistence call
- key→(persist?, cacheVar) table recorded as a comment

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_global_settings_contract.sh`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/shadow/shadow_ui_global_grid.mjs", "src/shadow/shadow_ui.js", "tests/host/test_global_settings_contract.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_global_settings_contract.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["each key routes to its correct backend", "all six MUST_PERSIST keys call persist() on write", "cache vars still written", "test fails when a persisting key skips its persistence call", "key to persist/cacheVar table recorded as a comment"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
